en:
## New Features

- Message multi-select with batch operations: copy, delete, and fork multiple messages at once via floating toolbar, with Ctrl/Cmd+Click toggle and Shift+Click range selection
- File modification timeline in FileSummaryTab: browse historical file states by message, with diff view filtered by upToMessageId
- WebFetch proxy configuration: choose between direct, system, or custom proxy with full frontend settings integration

## Bug Fixes

- Worktree watcher rewritten to manual tree walk + non-recursive fs.watch, skipping .git/node_modules directories to fix Linux CPU saturation from excessive inotify watches
- deleteMessageBlocks returns failed count, frontend uses invalidateQueries instead of full rollback for consistent state on partial failures
- useSwipeMenu tick function throttled via rAF to reduce unnecessary re-renders from high-frequency scroll/MutationObserver events
- Proxy URL validation now requires protocol prefix
- upToMessageId returns 404 when invalid
- Fixed Biome optional chain warning

## Refactoring

- ExitPlanMode plan resolution simplified: removed planFile parameter, unified logic from tool layer into session layer (handlePermission), with defensive empty plan check in execute()
zh-CN:
## 新功能

- 消息多选批量操作：通过浮动工具栏支持批量复制、删除和分叉，Ctrl/Cmd+Click 切换选中，Shift+Click 范围选中
- 文件修改时间线：FileSummaryTab 新增按消息查看历史文件状态，diff 端点支持 upToMessageId 过滤
- WebFetch 代理配置：支持直连、系统代理、自定义代理三种模式，前后端完整集成

## 修复

- worktree watcher 重写为手动 tree walk + 非递归 fs.watch，跳过 .git/node_modules 等目录，解决 Linux 下 inotify 过多导致 CPU 饱和问题
- deleteMessageBlocks 返回 failed 计数，前端改用 invalidateQueries 替代全量回滚，确保部分失败时状态一致
- useSwipeMenu tick 函数用 rAF 节流，减少 scroll/MutationObserver 高频触发时的无谓重渲染
- proxy URL 增加协议前缀校验
- upToMessageId 无效时返回 404
- 修复 Biome optional chain 警告

## 重构

- 简化 ExitPlanMode plan 解析逻辑：移除 planFile 参数，将逻辑从工具层收敛到会话层（handlePermission），execute() 中添加防御性空 plan 检查
